subject.title: Support storing UI preferences in config.json/preferences.json for dotfiles syncing

question: Should CodexBar add a portable JSON UI preference layer, and which settings plus precedence/write-back rules should be allowed?
rationale: This changes persisted user data behavior and privacy/storage boundaries, and VISION.md requires sign-off for new features and data-storage or privacy behavior changes.

options.title: Adopt separate opt-in preferences.json
options.body: Keep provider config secret-bearing, add a sparse portable preference file with explicit keys, safe unknown-field handling, and tested UserDefaults precedence.

options.title: Keep UI preferences in UserDefaults
options.body: Close or defer portable UI preferences to avoid new storage semantics and sync risks.

options.title: Provide export/import only
options.body: Avoid continuous sync while still giving users a manual way to move non-secret settings between Macs.

recommendation.title: Adopt separate opt-in preferences.json
recommendation.body: Keep provider config secret-bearing, add a sparse portable preference file with explicit keys, safe unknown-field handling, and tested UserDefaults precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent config/settings boundary work and already authored and closed the prototype branch with the next implementation constraints.
